verses.text: Jewe Pawulo nahamagariwe kuba intumwa ya Kristo Yesu bivuye ku gushaka kw’Imana, hamwe na mwene Data Sositene,

Turabandikiye mwebwe abo mw’ishengero ry’Imana riri i Korinto, mwejejwe no kuba muri Kristo Yesu kandi mwahamagariwe kuba abera, hamwe n’abo bose bambaza izina ry’Umwami Yesu Kristo aho bari hose, bakamwambaza nk’Umwami wabo ari we Mwami wacu:
Ubuntu n’amahoro biva ku Mana Data wa twese no ku Mwami wacu Yesu Kristo bibe muri mwebwe.
Nama nshima Imana ku bwanyu ku bw’ingabire y’ubuntu mwaherewe muri Kristo Yesu.
Muri we mwahawe ubutunzi mu buryo bwose, haba mu mvugo no mu bumenyi mufise.
Ivyo vyerekana ko intahe ya Kristo twabashingiye yabaye ukuri muri mwebwe.
Ni co gituma ata ngabire n’imwe muhajije muri iki gihe mukirindiranye igishika uguhishurwa kw’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
Ni we azobaha gushikama gushika kw’iherezo, kugira ngo muzobe mutagira umugayo ku musi Yesu Kristo azogarukirako.
Imana yabahamagariye kunywana n’Umwana wayo Yesu Kristo Umwami wacu, ni iyo kwizigirwa, izobikora.
Ndabinginga bene Data, mw’izina ry’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo, ngo muhuze muri vyose, kandi ntihabeho ukwicamwo ibice, ariko mutunganywe rwose muhuje umutima n’inama.
Bene Data, bamwe bo mu muryango wa Kilowe bambwiye ko hari imitongano muri mwebwe.

Ico ngomba kuvuga ni iki: umwe muri mwebwe avuga ngo: “Jewe ndi umwigishwa wa Pawulo”; uwundi na we ati: “Jewe ndi umwigishwa wa Apolo”; uwundi na we ati: “Jewe ndi uwa Kefa”; hakaba n’uwundi avuga ati: “Jeho ndi umwigishwa wa Kristo gusa.”
Mbega Kristo agabuwemwo ibice? Mbega Pawulo yarababambiwe? Mbega mwabatijwe mw’izina rya Pawulo?
Ndashimira Imana ko ata n’umwe nabatije muri mwebwe kiretse Kirisipo na Gayo,
nta n’umwe rero ashobora kuvuga ko yabatijwe mw’izina ryanje.
(Egome narabatije n’abo mu muryago wa Setefana, ariko atari abo, sinibuka ko hari uwundi muntu n’umwe noba narabatije.)
Kuko Kristo ntiyantumye kubatiza, ariko yantumye kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza, ntakoresheje amajambo y’ubwenge bw’abantu, kugira ngo simpindure ubusa ubushobozi bw’umusaraba wa Kristo.
Mu bisanzwe ubutumwa bw’umusaraba ni ubujuju ku bariko barahona, ariko kuri twebwe abariko barakizwa, ni ubushobozi bw’Imana.
Kuko handitswe ngo: “Nzosangangura ubwenge bw’abanyabwenge, n’ubumenyi bw’abiyita ko bazi vyinshi ndabuhindure ubusa.”
None umunyabwenge ari he? Umwigisha w’ivyagezwe ari he? Umusesanguzi w’amajambo w’iki gihe ari he? Mbega Imana ntiyafashe ubwenge bw’iyi si ikabuhindura ubujuju?
Kuko Imana mu bwenge bwayo yabonye ko ab’isi batoyimenya bakoresheje ubwenge bwabo, ni co gituma yahisemwo gukirisha abizera amajambo y’Ubutumwa Bwiza, ayo bamwe bita ubujuju.
Abayuda bashaka kubona ibimenyetso, Abagiriki na bo bakarondera kubitahurisha ubwenge bwabo.
Ariko tweho twigisha Kristo yabambwe: uwo ni igitsitaza ku Bayuda, n’ubujuju ku Banyamahanga.
Ariko ku bahamagawe, baba Abayuda canke Abagiriki, Kristo ni ubushobozi n’ubwenge vy’Imana.
Kuko ivyitwa ubujuju vy’Imana birusha ubwenge abantu kandi ivyitwa intege nke vy’Imana birusha inkomezi abantu.
Bene Data, mwibuke uko mwari igihe mwahamagarwa. Benshi muri mwebwe ntimwari abanyabwenge dufatiye ku vyo abantu baraba. Benshi ntimwari abahambaye, kandi benshi ntimuvuka mu miryango ikomeye.
Ariko Imana yahisemwo ivy’ubujuju vy’iyi si kugira ngo imaramaze abiyita abanyabwenge, kandi yahisemwo ibinyantege nke vy’iyi si kugira ngo itetereze ibinyenkomezi.
Imana yahisemwo ibitagira ikimazi vy’iyi si n’ibikengerwa ndetse n’ibitariho kugira ngo ihindure ubusa ibiriho.
Ivyo yabikoze kugira ngo ntihagire n’umwe agira ico yirata imbere y’Imana.
Imana ni yo yabagize umwe na Kristo Yesu, we yatubereye ubwenge buva ku Mana. Ni we kugororoka kwacu, ukwera kwacu kandi ni we ugucungurwa kwacu gukomokako.
Ni co gituma handitswe ngo: “Uwirata wese yirate ko yamenye Umwami Yesu.”

headings.text: Pawulo ashima Imana ku bw’ab’i Korinto
Kristo ni we bwenge n’ubushobozi bw’Imana

verses.text: Bene Data, igihe naza iwanyu, sinaje mfise amajambo aryohoye arimwo ugushira amazinda, canke ubwenge bw’abantu mu kubamenyesha ibanga ry’Imana.
Kuko nahisemwo kutagira ikindi mvuga igihe nari kumwe namwe, atari Yesu Kristo wenyene, umwe yabambwa ku musaraba.
Naje iwanyu ndi umunyantegenke, mfise ubwoba kandi mpinda agashitsi.
Ubutumwa bwanje n’ukwigisha kwanje ntivyarimwo ubwenge bwinshi n’amajambo yo kwemeza abantu, ariko yagaragaramwo ubushobozi bwa Mpwemu Yera,
kugira ngo ukwizera kwanyu ntiguhagarare ku bwenge bw’abantu, ahubwo guhagarare ku bushobozi bw’Imana.
Ariko ku bakuze mu kwizera, ubutumwa tuvuga ni ubw’ubwenge: ubwo bwenge si ubw’iki gihe canke ubw’abatware b’iki gihe bazokurwaho.
Ahubwo tubabwira ubwenge bw’Imana bwari bwaragizwe ibanga, bwari bwaranyegejwe, ariko Imana ikaba yari yabuduteguriye isi itararemwa kugira ngo buzoduhe ubwiza.
Nta n’umwe wo mu baganza b’iki gihe yigeze abutahura, kuko iyo baba barabutahuye, ntibaba barabamvye Umwami w’ubwiza.

Ivyanditswe bivuga biti: “Ibintu ata jisho na rimwe ryigeze kubibona, ibintu ata gutwi na kumwe kwigeze kuvyumva, kandi ibintu ata bwenge bw’umuntu n’umwe bwigeze kuvyiyumvira, ni vyo Imana yateguriye abayikunda.”
Ariko ivyo nyene ni vyo Imana yaduhishuriye biciye muri Mpwemu wayo. Mpwemu asesangura vyose, mbere n’ibihishijwe vy’amabanga y’Imana.
Nk’uko ata wushobora kumenya ivyiyumviro vy’umuntu atari impwemu yiwe, nta n’uwushobora kumenya ivyiyumviro vy’Imana atari Mpwemu wayo.
Kandi ntitwahawe impwemu y’iyi si, ariko twahawe Mpwemu ava ku Mana, kugira ngo dutahure ivy’akaburarugero Imana yaduhereye ubuntu.
Ivyo tubabwira ntitubivugisha ubwenge bw’abantu, ariko tubabwira ivyo duhawe na Mpwemu, tukabivuga mu kuri kwa Mpwemu, dukoresheje n’amajambo duhawe na Mpwemu.
Umuntu adafise Mpwemu ntashobora kwakira ibiva kuri Mpwemu w’Imana, kuko bisa n’ubujuju kuri we, kandi ntashobora kubitahura kuko bisesangurwa biciye muri Mpwemu.
Abantu bafise Mpwemu Yera basesangura vyose ariko bo nta wusesangura ivyabo,
kuko handitswe ngo: “Ni nde yigeze amenya ivyiyumviro vy’Uhoraho kugira ngo amugire inama?” Ariko tweho turabitahura kuko dufise ivyiyumviro vya Kristo.
Bene Data, igihe nari kumwe namwe sinabigishije nk’uko nokwigisha abantu bakuze mu Mpwemu, nabigishije nk’abantu basanzwe bo mw’isi, nk’abana bato mu vy’ukwizera Kristo.
Nabahaye amata, sinabahaye ivyokurya bigumye, kuko ntimwari bwagere kubishobora, kandi n’ubu ntimurabishobora.

Muracagendera mu ngeso zanyu za kera zo mw’isi kuko muracagiriranira ishari kandi muracatongana. None ivyo ntivyerekana ko mukigendera mu ngeso zanyu za kera? Mbega ntimubayeho nk’abandi bose batizera?
Iyo umwe muri mwebwe avuze ati: “Jewe ndi umwigishwa wa Pawulo,” uwundi ati: “Nanje ndi umwigishwa wa Apolo,” ntimuba muriko mwigenza nk’ab’iyi si?
Mbega Apolo ni iki, canke Pawulo ni iki? Ni abakozi b’Imana basanzwe babafashije mu gushika ku kwizera nk’uko Imana yakoresheje umwumwe wese muri bo.
Jewe nabivye imbuto, Apolo na we arazivomera, ariko Imana ni yo yazikujije.
None rero, yaba uwabivye, yaba uwavomeye, bompi nta co bamaze. Imana yonyene ikuza ni yo ihambaye.
Uwubiba n’uwuvomera bompi bafise intumbero imwe, kandi umwe wese azoherwa impera ku gikorwa yakoze,
kuko twempi dukorera Imana, namwe muri umurima w’Imana, muri inzu yayo.
Kubera ubuntu nagiriwe n’Imana, nashizeho urufatiro nk’umwubatsi w’umuhinga, hanyuma haza uwundi muntu arwubakako. Ariko uwurwubakako wese yiyubare uburyo arwubakako.
Kuko ata wushobora gushiraho urundi rufatiro atari urwo nashizeho, ari rwo Yesu Kristo.
Uwurwubakako wese ashobora gukoresha ibikoresho bitandukanye: inzahabu, ifeza, amabuye y’agaciro kanini, ibiti, ibishakashaka canke ivyatsi.
Ariko umusi w’imanza uzogaragaza igikorwa c’umwumwe wese kuko uzohishuranwa n’umuriro, kandi uwo na wo uzokwerekana agaciro k’igikorwa c’umuntu wese.
Ibikorwa vyiwe nivyarama, azohabwa impera.
Ariko uwo muriro niwabitongora, uwo mwubatsi azohomba impera yavyo, ariko wewe arokoka ameze kurya k’uwokowe mu muriro.
Mbega ntimuzi ko muri urusengero rw’Imana kandi ko Mpwemu w’Imana aba muri mwebwe?
Nihagira uwusambura urusengero rw’Imana, na we Imana izomurandura, kuko urusengero rw’Imana ari urwera, kandi urwo rusengero ni mwebwe.
Ntimwihende! Nimba muri mwebwe hari uwibaza ko ari umunyabwenge afatiye ku rugero rw’ubwenge bwo mw’isi, yari akwiye kuba ikijuju kugira ngo ashobore kuba umunyabwenge w’ukuri,
kuko imbere y’Imana ubwenge bw’iyi si ari ubujuju, nk’uko Ivyanditswe Vyera bivuga biti: “Imana ifatira abigira abanyabwenge mu bugunge bwabo.”
Ahandi na ho handitswe ngo: “Umwami Imana arazi ivyiyumviro vy’uwigira umunyabwenge, kandi arazi ko ari ubusa gusa.”
Nuko rero ntihakagire uwirata ko ari umwigishwa w’umuntu n’umwe, kuko vyose ari ivyanyu:
yaba Pawulo, yaba Apolo, yaba Kefa, yaba isi, yaba ubugingo canke urupfu, yaba ibiriho canke ibizoza, vyose ni ivyanyu,
namwe muri aba Kristo, Kristo na we ni uw’Imana.
Nuko rero mwese mudufate nk’abakozi ba Kristo, abo Imana yajeje kumenyekanisha amabanga yayo yahishuye.
Iyo umukozi ajejwe ibintu, ico asabwa ni ukuba umwizigirwa.
Ku binyerekeye, nta co bintwaye gucirwa urubanza namwe canke n’ubundi bucamanza bwose bw’abantu. Ariko jewe ubwanje nta rubanza nicira.
Mu mutima wanje nta jwi rinyagiriza ikibi, ariko ivyo ntibisigura ko nera. Umwami Imana ni we ancira urubanza.

Ni co gituma mudakwiye guca urubanza igihe co guca imanza kitaragera; nimurindire gushika Umwami Yesu agarutse. Ni we azonyegurura ivyanyegejwe mu mwijima, yongere ashire ahabona ivyiyumviro vyo mu mitima y’abantu. Aho ni ho umuntu wese azohabwa n’Imana ishimwe rimukwiye.

Bene Data, natanze akarorero kuri jewe no kuri Apolo ku bwanyu, kugira ngo mutwigireko iri jambo rivuga riti: “Ntimukarenge ku vyanditswe;” aho ni ho ata n’umwe muri mwebwe azokwirata kuba umwigishwa w’umwe ngo amurutishe uwundi.
Mbega ni nde yababwiye ko muruta abandi? Hari ico mufise mutahawe? None nimba ico mufise cose mwaragihawe, ni kuki mwishira hejuru nk’aho mutagihawe?
Mwibaza ko mukwije vyose! Mwibaza ko mumaze gutunga! Muramaze no kuba abami tutari kumwe! Icompa mukaba abami vy’ukuri kugira ngo tuganzanye namwe.

Ku bwanje, twebwe intumwa tumeze nk’imbohe z’intambara zigenewe kwicwa. Imana yadushize ku murongo inyuma y’abadufashe mpiri, mu birori vyabo vyo kwigina intsinzi. Twahindutse akamenyo kw’isi yose, mu maso y’abamarayika no mu maso y’abantu.
Turi ibijuju ku bwa Kristo, ariko mweho mwigira abanyabwenge muri Kristo. Turi abanyantegenke, ariko mweho mwigira abanyenkomezi. Muri abanyacubahiro, ariko twebwe turakengeretse.
Gushika n’ubu turasonza kandi tukanyoterwa, ntitugira ico twambara, turakubitwa, kandi ntitugira aho tuba.
Dukoresha amaboko yacu tukaruha kugira ngo turonke ibidutunga. Duhezagira abatuvuma, tukihanganira guhamwa.
Iyo batuvuze nabi, twishurana ubugwaneza. Gushika n’ubu dufatwa nk’umwavu wo kw’isi, ivyatawe na bose.
Sindabandikiye ibi kugira ngo ndabamaramaze, ahubwo nipfuza kubaburira nk’abana banje nkunda cane.
Kuko naho mufise abarezi ibihumbi cumi muri Kristo, ntimufise ba so benshi, kuko ni jewe nabavyaje Ubutumwa Bwiza muri Kristo Yesu.
Ndabinginga rero ngo munyigane.
Ni co gituma nabarungikiye Timoteyo, umwana wanje nkunda kandi w’umwizigirwa mu Mwami. Azobibutsa ingene mbayeho muri Kristo Yesu, nk’uko ndavyigisha hose mu mashengero yose.
Bamwe muri mwebwe batewe n’ubwibone bibaza ko ntazoza kubagendera.
Ariko, Umwami Imana niyabikunda, nzobagendera vuba, kandi sinzokwumviriza gusa amajambo y’abo bantu b’ubwibone, ahubwo nzorondera kumenya nimba bakoreshwa n’ubushobozi bw’Imana.
Kuko Ubwami bw’Imana atari amajambo gusa, ahubwo ni ubushobozi.
Mbega mugomba nzobagendere nzanye inkoni yo kubahana? Canke icoba ciza ni uko noza mfise umutima w’urukundo n’ubugwaneza?
Narumvise ko hari ingeso y’ubusambanyi hagati muri mwebwe, ubusambanyi butaba no mu bantu batizera Imana: numvise ko hari umugabo yarongoye umugore wa se.
Kandi ikibabaje, aho gutuntuzwa n’ivyo, maze umuntu yabikoze mukamutaramura muri mwebwe, mubandanya mwishira hejuru.
N’aho ntari kumwe namwe mu buryo bw’umubiri, ndi kumwe namwe mu buryo bw’impwemu. Uwo muntu yakoze ivyo naramaze kumucira urubanza nk’aho noba ndi kumwe namwe.
Nuko rero nimwakorana mw’izina ry’Umwami wacu Yesu, nanje nkabana namwe mu buryo bw’impwemu, ubushobozi bw’Umwami wacu buzoba buri hagati muri twebwe,
maze uwo muntu muze mumuhe Satani kugira ngo akamere k’icaha kiwe karanduke, ariko impwemu yiwe izorokoke ku musi w’Umwami Imana.
Ntivyari bikwiye ko mwishira hejuru. Mbega ntimuzi ko icaha kimeze nk’umwambiro mukeya bashira mu gikandu maze kigatutumba cose?
Nimukure rero muri mwebwe umwambiro wa kera, kugira ngo mube igikandu kitagira umwambiro. Mu vy’ukuri ni co muri, kuko Kristo, umwagazi w’intama wa Pasika, yatanzwe nk’ikimazi ku bwacu.

Ni co gituma dukwiye guhimbaza uwo musi mukuru tudakoresheje imikate irimwo umwambiro wa kera, ari wo mwambiro w’ubugunge n’ubukozi bw’ikibi, ariko dukoresheje imikate itarimwo umwambiro, ari vyo kutagira uburyarya no kuba abanyakuri.
Igihe nabandikira ubwa mbere nari nababujije kwifatanya n’abantu b’ingeso z’ubusambanyi.
Simvuga abantu bo mu b’iyi si bagendera mu ngeso z’ubusambanyi, canke ingunge, canke abasuma, canke abasenga ibigirwamana, kuko vyosaba ko muva muri iyi si kugira mushobore kwirinda abantu nk’abo.
Ahubwo nababwira kutifatanya n’uwigira mwene Data ariko ari umusambanyi, ingunge, asenga ibigirwamana, avuga nabi abandi, aborerwa, canke yiba. Umuntu nk’uwo ntimukwiye no gusangira ivyokurya.
Si igikorwa canje gucira urubanza abatari mw’ishengero, ariko ni igikorwa canyu gucira urubanza ababandanya bakora ivyaha bari mw’ishengero.
Imana ni yo izocira urubanza abatizera, ariko nk’uko Ivyanditswe bivuga, “Nimwirukane inkozi y’ikibi iri hagati muri mwebwe.”
Iyo umwe muri mwebwe agize ico apfa na mwene Data wundi, ni kuki amwitwarira mu batubaha Imana ngo babe ari bo babacira urubanza, aho kwitura abizera ngo babatature?
Mbega ntimuzi ko abizera ari bo bazocira imanza isi? None nimba muzocira imanza isi, mwonanirwa no gutatura amatati asanzwe?
Mbega ntimuzi ko muzocira imanza n’abamarayika? Ni co gituma mwari mukwiye gutatura amatati asanzwe yo muri buno buzima.
None iyo hadutse amatati yo muri ubu buzima, ni kuki muja kuronderera abacamanza mu bantu batanemewe mw’ishengero?
Ibi ndabivuze kugira ngo ndabamaramaze. Birashoboka ko muri mwebwe habura n’umwe afise ubwenge, ashoboye gutatura amatati ari hagati mu bizera?
Ariko aho gutatura ayo matati mwebwe nyene, mwene Data umwe yitwarira mugenziwe, kandi akamwitwarira ku batizera!
No kuba mufitaniye imanza hagati yanyu, ivyo vyonyene vyerekana ko mwamaze kunanirwa. Ni kuki mudashobora kwihanganira akarenganyo? Ni kuki mudashobora kwihanganira ababiba?
Ariko ntibitangaje na mwebwe ubwanyu murarenganya mukongera mukiba, kandi ivyo mukabikorera bene Data bandi.

Mbega ntimuzi ko inkozi z’ibibi zitazoragwa Ubwami bw’Imana? Ntimukibeshe: abihumanisha ibijanye n’ibitsina, abasenga ibigirwamana, abasambanyi, abagabo bihindura abagore mu bumaraya, abahuza ibitsina n’abafise ibisa n’ivyabo,
abasuma, ingunge, imborerwa, abavuga nabi abandi, n’abambuzi ntibazoragwa Ubwami bw’Imana.
Kandi bamwe muri mwebwe bari bameze nk’abo. Ariko mwarogejwe, murezwa, mwongera mwemerwa n’Imana nk’abagororotsi mw’izina ry’Umwami Yesu Kristo, mubihawe na Mpwemu w’Imana yacu.
Hari uwuvuga ati: “Vyose ndavyemerewe.” Ni vyo, ariko si vyose bingirira akamaro. Naho vyose ndavyemerewe, sinemera kuganzwa n’ikintu na kimwe.

Uwundi avuga ati: “Ivyokurya ni ivy’inda, n’inda ni iy’ivyokurya kandi Imana izobirandura vyompi.” Yamara umubiri ntiwaremewe kuganzwa n’ubusambanyi, ariko waremewe kuba uw’Umwami Imana, kandi ni we awitaho.
Imana, mu bushobozi bwayo, yazuye Umwami Yesu mu bapfuye, kandi natwe izotuzura.
Mbega ntimuzi ko imibiri yanyu ari ibihimba vy’umubiri wa Kristo? None nubahuke mfate ibihimba vy’umubiri wa Kristo, ndabifatanye n’umumaraya? Ntibikabe!
Mbega ntimuzi ko uwifatanije n’umumaraya aba abaye umubiri umwe na we? Kuko Ivyanditswe Vyera bivuga ngo: “Uko ari babiri bazoba babaye umubiri umwe.”
Ariko uwifatanije n’Umwami Imana aba abaye umwe na we mu buryo bw’impwemu.
Mwirinde ubusambanyi. Nta kindi caha gifise ingaruka ku mubiri kunganya ico. Uwusambana aba acumuye no ku mubiri wiwe na wo.
Mbega ntimuzi ko imibiri yanyu ari insengero za Mpwemu Yera aba muri mwebwe, uwo mwahawe n’Imana? Erega ntimuciganza
kuko mwaguzwe igiciro kinini. Nuko rero mwubahishe Imana imibiri yanyu.

headings.text: Imibiri yacu ni Ingoro za Mpwemu Yera

verses.text: Ku bijanye n’ivyo mwambajije mw’ikete mwanyandikiye, ni vyiza ko umuntu atorongora.
Ariko kubera ubusambanyi ari bwinshi, umugabo wese akwiye kugira umugore wiwe, kandi n’umugore wese akwiye kugira umugabo wiwe.
Umugabo ategerezwa kurangura amabanga y’abubatse n’umugore wiwe, n’umugore wiwe ni uko nyene.
Umugore aba yemeye guha umubiri wiwe umugabo ngo abe ari we awuganza, kandi n’umugabo n’uko aba yemeye guha umubiri wiwe umugore ngo abe ari we awuganza.

Ntihakagire uwanka kurangura amabanga y’abubatse n’uwundi, kiretse mwumvikanye kwihangana igihe gito, kugira ngo mufate umwanya wo gusenga. Hanyuma mugaca musubira kubana bisanzwe kugira ngo Satani ntaronke aho abaca ngo abageragereshe ukunanirwa kuganza imibiri yanyu.
Ibi ndabibabwiye nk’impanuro si itegeko ndabahaye.
Ico nipfuza ni uko abantu bose boba nkanje. Ariko umuntu wese afise ingabire yisangije yahawe n’Imana; umwe agira ingabire kanaka, uwundi akagira iyindi.
Abatubatse n’abapfakaye bakwiye kuguma uko bari, nk’uko nanje ndi.
Ariko nimba badashobora kuganza imibiri yabo, bakwiye kwubaka, kuko umuntu yopfuma agira uwo bubakanye hako arengerwa n’ivyipfuzo vy’umubiri.
Ku bubatse, ntanze iri tegeko, ritavuye kuri jewe ariko rivuye ku Mwami Imana: umugore ntakahukane n’umugabo wiwe.
Ariko bishitse akahukana, ntaze asubire kurongorwa, canke na ho aze asubirane n’umugabo wiwe. N’umugabo na we ntakirukane umugore wiwe.
Abandi na bo, ibi ni vyo ndababwira, ariko ni jewe ubwanje, si Umwami Imana: mwene Data niyaba afise umugore atizera hanyuma uwo mugore agashaka kugumana na we, ntaze amwirukane.
Kandi mwene Data niyaba afise umugabo atizera, maze uwo mugabo akaba ashaka kugumana na we, ntaze avane na we.

Kuko umubano n’umugabo atizera wezwa biciye ku mugore wiwe yizera, kandi n’umubano hamwe n’umugore atizera wezwa biciye ku mugabo wiwe yizera. Ahandi ho abana banyu bobaye abahumanye, ariko noneho barejejwe.

Ariko umugabo atizera canke umugore atizera agomvye kuvana n’uwo bubakanye yizera, amureke yigire. Muri ico gihe uwo mugabo canke uwo umugore yizera ntaba akibohewe kuri uwo bubakanye atizera, kuko Imana yaduhamagariye kuba mu mahoro.
Mbega wa mugore we, ni igiki kikwemeza ko umugabo wawe azokizwa kubera wewe? Canke wa mugabo we, ni igiki kikwemeza ko umugore wawe azokizwa kubera wewe?
Ariko rero umuntu wese akwiye kubaho ubuzima rukristo mu bihe vyose n’ahantu hose Umwami yamugeneye, kandi yisunze uko Imana yamuhamagaye. Iri ni ryo tegeko ntanga mu mashengero yose.
Nk’akarorero, nimba umugabo yari yarakebwe imbere yuko ahamagarwa, ntarondere kubihindura. Niyaba na ho atari yarakebwe igihe yahamagarwa, ntarondere gukebwa.
Ugukebwa canke ukudakebwa vyompi nta co bimaze. Igihambaye ni ugukurikiza amabwirizwa y’Imana.
Umuntu wese akwiye kuguma uko yari ameze igihe Imana yamuhamagara.
Nimba wari umugurano igihe Imana yaguhamara, ntibiguhagarike umutima. Ariko niwaronka ibakwe ryo kwidegemvya, widegemvye.
Kuko uwahamagawe n’Umwami ari umugurano aba abaye uwidegemvya mu Mwami, kandi uwahamagawe n’Umwami yidegemvya aba abaye umugurano wa Kristo.
Mwaguzwe igiciro kinini; nuko rero ntimukabe abaja b’abantu.
Bene Data, umuntu wese agume nk’uko yari ameze igihe Imana yamuhamagara.
Ku vyerekeye abatararongorwa, nta bwirizwa nahawe n’Umwami, ariko ndababwira ico niyumvira nk’umuntu w’umwizigirwa yagiriwe ubuntu n’Umwami.
Kubera ibihe bigoye turimwo, niyumvira ko umuntu yoguma uko asanzwe ari ubu.
Nimba wararongoye, nturondere kwahukana. Nimba utarongora, nturondere kurongora.
Urongoye nta caha uba ukoze, kandi inkumi irongowe, nta caha iba ikoze. Ariko abarongora bazobona amakuba menshi muri buno buzima, nkaba numva nshaka kuyabarinda.
Bene Data, ico ngomba kuvuga ni uko igihe gisigaye ari gito. Uhereye ubu, abafise abagore ntibiteho cane ivy’ingo gusa,
abarira babeho nk’abatarira, abari mu munezero babeho nk’abatanezerewe, abagura ibintu bamere nk’abatabifise.
Abari mu rudandazwa ntibatwarwe na rwo, kuko iyi si turimwo ubu igiye gukurwaho vuba.
Nipfuza ko mubaho mwidegemvya, ata mwitwarariko w’ivy’ubu buzima. Umugabo atarongoye yitwararika ibikorwa vy’Umwami, akama arondera ingene amunezereza.
Ariko uwarongoye yitwararika ivy’ino si, akarondera ingene yonezereza umugore wiwe.

Mu mutima wiwe aba akwegwa irya n’ino. Umugore canke inkumi itarongowe yitwararika ibikorwa vy’Umwami. Yihebera Umwami mu mubiri no mu mpwemu. Ariko uwarongowe yitwararika ivy’ino si, arondera ingene yonezereza umugabo wiwe.
Ibi ndiko ndabivuga ku neza yanyu, sindiko ndabaremereza amategeko. Nshaka ko mukora ikiborohereza gukorera neza Umwami ata bibasamaza.
None rero, umusore niyaba yipfuza cane umukobwa bazokwubakana, agatinya ko azohava amukorera ibidakwiye kuko vyanse ko yihangana, namurongore nk’uko avyipfuza, nta caha azoba akoze.
Ariko nimba umusore yafashe ingingo mu mutima wiwe yo kutarongora, avyihitiyemwo kandi akaba ashoboye kwigumya, na we nyene aba agize neza.
Nuko rero uwurongoye inkumi yahisemwo aba agize neza, ariko uwutarongoye aba agize neza gusumba.
Umugore aba abohewe ku mugabo iyo akiriho. Ariko umugabo amaze gupfa, umugore aba afise uburenganzira bwo kurongorwa n’uwo ashaka wundi, mu gihe uwo mugabo aba yubaha Umwami Imana.
Ariko jewe niyumvira ko yonezerwa gusumba agumye uko yari ari, kandi nanje ndabahaye iyi mpanuro ndongowe na Mpwemu w’Imana.
Ku bijanye n’ivyashikaniwe ibigirwamana, ndazi ko twese dufise ico tubiziko. Ariko ubumenyi butuma umuntu yishira hejuru; urukundo ni rwo rwubaka.
Iyo umuntu yibwira ko azi ikintu, ntaba arakimenya gushika ku rugero yategerezwa gushitsako mu kukimenya.
Ariko uwukunda Imana we na yo iramuzi.
None rero ku bijanye n’ivyashikaniwe ibigirwamana, turazi ko ikigirwamana ari ubusa ngaha kw’isi, kandi ko hari Imana imwe gusa.
Hari ivyitwa “imana” vyinshi kw’isi no kw’ijuru, kandi hari abantu basenga imana nyinshi n’abami benshi.
Ariko tuzi ko hari Imana imwe, ari yo Data, yaremye vyose kandi tubayeho ku bwayo. Hari Umwami umwe, ari we Yesu Kristo. Vyose vyaremewe muri we, kandi muri we ni ho twaherewe ubugingo.

Ariko abizera bose ntibafise ubwo bumenyi. Bamwe baramenyereye gusenga ibigirwamana gushika aho n’ubu, iyo bariye ivyashikaniwe ivyo bigirwamana, kandi bakabirya bafise ico ciyumviro, baca bagirizwa mu mitima yabo itarakomera, bakumva ko bihumanije.
Ariko, imfungurwa si zo zitwegereza Imana; tubiriye ntiduca tuba babi imbere y’Imana kandi tutabiriye ntiduca tuba beza.
Ariko mube maso kugira ngo umwidegemvyo wanyu ntutume abanyantegenke bakora icaha.
Mbega umuntu w’umunyantegenke niyakubona wewe umusumvya ugutahura uriko urira mu ngoro y’ibigirwamana, ntibizotuma kubera intege nke ziwe, aca arya ivyashikaniwe ibigirwamana?
Nuko rero, uwo mwene Data w’umunyantegenke Kristo yapfiriye, ntimumuranduze ugutahura kwanyu.
Mucumuye kuri bene Data muri ubwo buryo, muba mucumuye kuri Kristo.
Ni co gituma, nimba ivyokurya vyotuma mwene Data akora icaha, sinzokwigera ndya inyama kugira ngo sintume atsitara akagwa.
Mbega sindi uwidegemvya? Mbega sindi intumwa? Mbega siniboneye Yesu Umwami wacu amaso mu yandi? Mbega ntimuri ivyamwa vy’ibikorwa nakoreye Umwami?
N’aho ntoba intumwa ku bandi, kuri mwebwe ndi yo. Namwe ubwanyu muri icemeza uko ndi intumwa y’Umwami.
Iki ni co nireguza ku bancira imanza.
Mbega ntitwemerewe guhabwa ivyokurya n’ivyo kunywa?
Mbega ntitwemerewe kubana n’abagore bizera nk’uko izindi ntumwa, abavukanyi b’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo na Kefa babigira?
Canke ni jewe na Baranaba dutegerezwa gukora twenyene kugira ngo twitunge?
Ni nde yoba umusoda hanyuma agategerezwa kwibeshaho? Ni nde yotera uruzabibu hanyuma ntarye ivyamwa vyarwo? Ni nde yoragira amasho hanyuma ntanywe amata yayo?
Mbega ibi ndabibabwiye bivuye mu vyiyumviro vy’abantu? Canke n’ivyagezwe vya Mose birafise ico bibivugako?
Muri ivyo vyagezwe haranditse ngo: “Ntimuze muzibire umunwa w’inka iriko irasekura ingano.” Mbega mwibaza ko ngaha Imana yariko ivuga inka isanzwe gusa?
Nta nkeka ibi ni twebwe yari ibivuzeko. Ibi vyandikiwe twebwe kugira ngo uwurima n’uwimbura bizigire kuzoronka umugabane wabo ku mwimbu.
Ko twababivyemwo imbuto mu buryo bw’impwemu, ntitwari dukwiye kubimburamwo ivyokurya vy’umubiri?

Nimba abandi babigisha bafise uburenganzira bwo kuronka ibibabeshaho muri mwebwe, mbega twebwe ntitwari dukwiye kuronka ibirenze? Ariko ntitwigeze duharanira ubwo burenganzira. Ahubwo turimenya muri vyose kugira ntitube intambamyi ku Butumwa Bwiza bwa Kristo.
Mbega ntimuzi ko abakora mu rusengero barya ivyo mu rusengero, kandi ko n’abakora ku gicaniro barya ivyashikanywe ku gicaniro?
Ni muri ubwo buryo nyene, Umwami yategetse ko abavuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bazotungwa n’ubwo Butumwa nyene.

Ariko sinigeze ngwanira na kimwe muri ibi nari nemerewe, kandi sindabandikiye iri kete kugira ngo mutangure kumpa ibimbeshaho. Nopfuma mpfa hako ntakaza ibi vyirato vyo kuvuga ubutumwa ata we ndemereye.
Ariko iyo mvuze ubutumwa, sinshobora kuvyirata kuko mba nshikije itegeko ry’Imana. Noba ngowe ntavuze Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Mvuze ubutumwa bivuye ku mutima ubikunze, ndonka impera. Ariko ndabuvuze umutima utabikunze, kuba ari ukwikurayo.
Mbega impera yanje ni iyihe? Ni uko mvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza ata we ndemereye, ntahagaze ku burenganzira nari mfise nk’umuvugabutumwa.
N’aho ndi uwidegemvya nkaba ntajakariye umuntu n’umwe, nigira umugurano ku bantu bose kugira ngo nshobore kuzana benshi kuri Kristo.
Ku Bayuda nabaye nk’uwuganzwa n’ivyagezwe n’aho ntaganzwa na vyo, kugira ngo nzane kuri Kristo abaganzwa n’ivyagezwe.
Ku banyamahanga batagira ivyagezwe nabayeho nk’uwutabigira n’aho nganzwa n’ivyagezwe vy’Imana, nkubaha ivyagezwe vya Kristo, kugira ngo nzane abatagira ivyagezwe kuri Kristo.
Ku banyantegenke nigize umunyantegenke kugira ngo nzane abanyantegenke kuri Kristo. Nabaye vyose kuri bose kugira nkore ibishoboka vyose hagire na bamwe muri bo bakizwa.
Ibi vyose ndabikora kugira Ubutumwa Bwiza bukwire hose, maze nanje nze mpabwe imigisha ijana na bwo.
Ntimuzi ko mw’ihiganwa hiruka benshi, ariko uwuhabwa umudari akaba umwe? Nuko rero muhiganwe nk’abazohabwa umudari.
Abaja mw’ihiganwa bose bagira imyiteguro ikomeye. Bayigira kugira bazoronke impera ihera, ariko twebwe tugira imyiteguro kugira tuzoronke impera ihoraho.
Nuko rero siniruka nk’uwutagira intumbero, canke uwugwana akubita ingumu ahusha uwo bagwana.
Ntoza indero umubiri wanje, nkawugira umuja wanje, kugira ngo maze kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza sinsange narushijwe mw’ihiganwa, nkabura impera.
Bene Data, singomba ko mwibagira ko ba sogokuruza mu bugaragwa bagendera musi y’igicu, kandi ko bose bajabutse baciye mu kiyaga.
Muri ico gicu no muri ico kiyaga, bose babatiririjwe kuba abigishwa ba Mose.
Bose bariye ivyokurya bimwe vy’impwemu,
banywa no ku kinyobwa kimwe c’impwemu; kuko banyoye ku gitandara c’impwemu cabaherekeza, ico gitandara na co cari Yesu Kristo ubwiwe.
Ariko benshi muri bo ntibanezereye Imana, kuko imivyimba yabo yandagaye mu bugaragwa.
Ivyo vyose vyabaye ngo bitubere akarorero kugira ngo imitima yacu ntiyipfuze gukora ivyaha nk’uko babigize.
Ntimugasenge ibigirwamana nk’uko bamwe muri bo babisenze, nk’uko handitswe ngo: “Baricaye bararya, baranywa, hanyuma barahaguruka barinezereza.”
Ntituje mu busambanyi nk’uko bamwe muri bo babigize, maze ku musi umwe gusa hagapfa abantu ibihumbi mirongo ibiri na bitatu.
Ntitugerageze Kristo nk’uko bamwe babigize bakamarwa n’inzoka.
Kandi ntimukidodombe nk’uko bamwe babigize, maze bakicwa n’umumarayika muranduzi.
Ivyo vyashitse kugira ngo bitubere akarorero ko kutuburira, twebwe abo mu gihe ca nyuma.
Nuko rero uwibaza ko ahagaze, yiyubare ntagwe.

Nta kibagerageza cabashikiye kidashikira abandi. Kandi Imana ni iyo kwizigirwa, ntizobareka ngo mugeragezwe n’ivyo mudashobora kwihanganira. Mu gihe co kugeragezwa, izobacira inzira kugira ngo mushobore kuvyihanganira.
None rero abo nkunda, mwirinde gusenga ibigirwamana.
Ndababwira nk’abafise ugutahura. Nimurabe mwebwe nyene ko ivyo ndababwira atari ukuri.
Iyo tunywera ku gikombe Imana yahezagiye, mbega ntituba dusangiye ku maraso ya Kristo? Iyo tumanyura umukate, ntituba dusangiye ku mubiri wa Kristo?
Iyo dusangiye ku mukate umwe tuba tubaye umubiri umwe n’aho turi benshi.
Nimurabe Abisirayeli: mbega abarya ivyatanzwe nk’ishikanwa ntibaba bifatanirije hamwe ku gicaniro?
Mbega ngomvye kuvuga ko ivyashikaniwe ibigirwamana canke ibigirwamana ubwavyo ata co bimaze?
Haba na mba. Ivyashikaniwe ibigirwamana biba vyashikaniwe abadayimoni, ari na co gituma ntashaka ko musangira n’abadayimoni.
Ntimushobora kunywera ku gikombe c’Umwami hanyuma ngo mwongere munywere ku gikombe c’abadayimoni. Ntimushobora kurira ku meza y’Umwami hanyuma ngo mwongere murire ku meza y’abadayimoni.
Mbega mugomba tuvyure ishari ry’Umwami? Mwibaza ko tumusumvya inguvu?
Muvuga muti: “Vyose turavyemerewe,” yamara si vyose bigira ikimazi. Muvuga muti: “Vyose turavyemerewe,” yamara si vyose vyubaka.
Ntihakagire uwurondera ineza yiwe gusa, ariko twiteho no kugirira abandi neza.
Muze murye inyama izo ari zo zose zashowe mu kaguriro, ata co murinze kuzibazako,
kuko “isi ari iy’Umwami Imana, n’ibiri muri yo vyose.”
Uwutizera niyagutumira iwe gufungura ukagenda, uzofungure ivyo akuzimanye vyose ata co urinze kuvyibazako.
Ariko niyakubwira ati: “Ibi vyashikaniwe ibigirwamana,” ntuzobirye ku bw’ineza y’uwo munyantegenke yabikubwiye, kugira ngo ntagire ijwi rimwagiriza mu mutima.
Nta co bitwaye kuri mwebwe, ariko hari ico vyica kuri uwo yabibabwiye. Umwidegemvyo wanje ntukwiye kuba igitsitaza ku bandi.
Iyo ndabiriyeko nshimira Imana, kubera iki abantu bancira imanza kuri ivyo vyokurya nashimiye Imana?
Nuko rero iyo murya canke munywa, canke mukora ikindi kintu cose, mubikore muhesha Imana icubahiro.
Ntihakagire uwo mutsitaza, yaba Umuyuda canke Umugiriki, canke abo mw’ishengero ry’Imana.
Na jewe ngerageza kunezereza bose mu vyo nkora vyose. Simpfa gukora ibimpimbara, ariko nkora ibihimbara abandi kugira benshi bashike ku gakiza.
Munyigane nk’uko nanje nigana Kristo.
Ndabashimira cane ko munyibuka mu vyo mukora vyose, kandi mukaba mwaragumije inyigisho zanje nk’uko nazibahaye.
Ariko hari ico mukwiye kumenya: umutwe w’umugabo ni Kristo, umutwe w’umugore ni umugabo wiwe, umutwe wa Kristo na wo ni Imana,
Umugabo asenga canke avugishwa n’Imana atwikiriye umutwe aba asuzuguje umutwe wiwe.
Ariko umugore asenga canke akavugishwa n’Imana adatwikiriye umutwe wiwe aba asuzuguje umutwe wiwe, co kimwe n’iyo yiharanguje.
Umugore adatwikiriye umutwe wiwe ariko arasenga, akwiye kumobwa. Kandi nimba ari igiterasoni ku mugore kumwa umushatsi canke kwiharanguza, nawutwikire.
Umugabo ntakwiye gutwikira umutwe wiwe, kuko umugabo ni ishusho y’ubwiza bw’Imana; ariko umugore ni ishusho y’ubwiza bw’umugabo.
Kuko umugabo ntiyavuye mu mugore, ariko umugore yavuye mu mugabo;
kandi umugabo ntiyaremwe ku bw’umugore, ariko umugore yaremwe ku bw’umugabo.
Ni co gutuma rero, kubera abamarayika batwihweza, umugore akwiye gutwikira umutwe wiwe, kugira yerekane ko ari musi y’ubundi bubasha.
Ariko mu Mwami, umugore yuzuza umugabo, kandi umugabo yuzuza umugore.
Kuko nk’uko umugore yavuye mu mugabo, umugabo na we avyarwa n’umugore. Ariko ibintu vyose biva ku Mana.
Nabe ari mwebwe nyene mwicira urubanza: Mbega birabereye ko umugore asenga Imana adatwikiriye umutwe wiwe?
Mbega mu vyo kamere y’ibintu itwigisha, si ibiterasoni ko umugabo atereka umushatsi,
ariko umugore awuteretse umubera ubwiza bwiwe? Kuko yawuhawe ngo umubere nk’igitambara kimutwikira.
Ariko nimba hariho uwufise ibihari kuri ibi, nobabwira ko ata wundi mugenzo dufise atari uwo, kandi n’ayandi mashengero y’Imana ni uko abikora.
Mu vyo ngira ndababwire, sindabashima na gato, kuko amakoraniro yanyu yuzuyemwo ibibi gusumba ivyiza.
Ica mbere, narumvise ko iyo mukoraniye mu rusengero mwicamwo ibice, kandi ndakeka ko ari vyo.
Sinkekeranya ko hoba hariho ukwitandukanya muri mwebwe, kugira ngo abemewe n’Imana bagaragare.
Iyo mukoranye, ntimurya ku ngaburo y’Umwami,
kuko iyo mufungura, bamwe muri mwebwe bihutira gufungura ivyabo ntibasangire n’abandi. Ivyo bituma haba abataha bashonje, abandi bagataha baborewe.
Mbega ntimufise iwanyu aho mwofungurira mukongera mukanywera? Canke mushaka kwonona urusengero rw’Imana no kumaramaza abakene? Ndababwire iki? Mbe mushaka ko ndabashima? Ntibishoboka!
Kuko ico nahawe n’Umwami ari co nanje nabashikirije: muri rya joro Umwami Yesu yagurishwa, yakiriye umukate,
awushimira Imana, arawumanyura, avuga ati: “Uwu ni umubiri wanje utanzwe ku bwanyu. Muzohore mukora gutya munyibuka.”
Bahejeje gufungura, agira uko nyene, afata igikombe, avuga ati: “Iki gikombe ni isezerano rishasha ritangujwe n’amaraso yanje. Muzohore mukora gutya, igihe cose mukinywereyeko, mubikore munyibuka.”
Kuko igihe cose muzorya uwu mukate mukanywera no kuri iki gikombe, muzoba muriko muramenyekanisha urupfu rwanje gushika aho nzogarukira.
Ni co gituma uwurya umukate akanywa no ku gikombe uko bitabereye aba acumuye ku mubiri n’amaraso vy’Umwami.
Umuntu wese akwiye kwisuzuma imbere yo kurya uwo mukate no kunywera kuri ico gikombe.
Kuko uwurya uwo mukate akanywera no kuri ico gikombe adahaye icubahiro umubiri wa Kristo aba yikwegeye gutsindwa n’urubanza.
Ni co gituma bamwe muri mwebwe bagira intege nke, bakagwara, ndetse abandi bakaba baranapfuye.
Iyo twirimbuye twebwe nyene tukicira urubanza, Imana ntiba ikiruduciriye.
Ariko Umwami aduciriye urubanza, aba adutoje indero kugira ngo ntituzocirwe urubanza hamwe n’abo mw’isi.
None rero bene Data, iyo mukoraniye ku ngaburo y’Umwami, mube murindirana.
Uwuzokwumva ashonje cane azofungure iwe kugira ngo yoye kwikwegera gutsindwa n’urubanza. Ku bindi bibazo mwanyandikiye, nzobaha inyishu ninashika iwanyu.
Bene Data, ibijanye n’ingabire za Mpwemu Yera, nshaka ko mubitahura neza.
Murazi ko mukiri abanyamahanga mwazimizwa n’ibigirwamana bitavuga.
Ni co gituma ndababwira ko ata wuvugishwa na Mpwemu w’Imana yovuga ati: “Yesu ni ikivume,” kandi nta wovuga ati: “Yesu ni Umwami,” kiretse abivugishijwe na Mpwemu Yera.
Hari ingabire zitandukanye ariko Mpwemu azitanga ni umwe.
Imirimo ni myinshi ariko Umwami dukorera ni umwe.
Ibikorwa vy’Imana ni vyinshi, ariko iyo Mana nyene ni yo ibikorera muri twebwe twese.
Mpwemu w’Imana yiyerekanira mu ngabire kuri umwumwe wese ku neza ya bose.
Bamwe bahawe na Mpwemu gutanga impanuro zirimwo ubwenge, abandi uwo Mpwemu nyene abaha ubumenyi budasanzwe,
abandi abaha ingabire y’ukwizera, abandi abaha gukiza ingwara,
abandi abaha ububasha bwo gukora ibitangaza, abandi abaha kuvugishwa n’Imana, abandi abaha kurobanura impwemu, abandi abaha kuvuga indimi zitamenyekana, abandi na bo abaha gusobanura izo ndimi.
Izo ngabire zose zitangwa na Mpwemu umwe, akaziha uwo agomba nk’uko abishatse.
Umubiri ni umwe n’aho ugizwe n’ibihimba vyinshi; kandi n’aho ibihimba vyawo ari vyinshi bigize umubiri umwe. N’umubiri wa Kristo ni uko.
Twese twabatijwe na Mpwemu umwe mu mubiri umwe: Abayuda, Abagiriki, abagurano, n’abidegemvya, kandi twese twahawe Mpwemu umwe.
Umubiri ntugizwe n’igihimba kimwe, ugizwe n’ibihimba vyinshi.
Ikirenge kivuze giti: “Ko ntari ukuboko, sindi igihimba c’umubiri,” ivyo ntivyotuma kireka kuba igihimba c’umubiri.
Kandi ugutwi kuvuze guti: “Ko ntari ijisho, sindi igihimba c’umubiri,” ivyo ntivyotuma kireka kuba igihimba c’umubiri.
Mbega nka hamwe umubiri wose woba ijisho gusa, kwumva vyoca bibera he? Canke na ho nka hamwe umubiri wose woba ugutwi, kumoterwa vyoca bibera he?
Ariko noneho Imana yashize ibihimba bitandukanye ku mubiri, kimwekimwe cose aho biyihimbaye kugishira.
Umubiri ntiwoba umubiri mu gihe woba ugizwe n’igihimba kimwe gusa.
Nk’uko bimeze rero, hari ibihimba vyinshi ariko umubiri ni umwe.
Ijisho ntiryobarira ukoboko riti: “Sindagukeneye,” kandi umutwe ntiwobwira ibirenge uti: “Sindabakeneye.”
Ahubwo n’ibihimba vyose womenga ni bitobito kurusha ibindi birakenewe cane.
Kandi ibihimba womenga ntivyubashwe cane ni vyo twitwararika cane kwambika. Ibihimba tutipfuza ko bija ahabona ni vyo twitwararika gufata neza,
ariko ibija ahabona tubifata ibisanzwe. Imana yafatanije ibihimba vy’umubiri vyose ica iha icubahiro ibitagifise,
kugira ngo ntihabe ukwitandukanya kw’umubiri, ahubwo ibihimba vyose vyitaneho ku rugero rungana.
Iyo hagize igihimba kimwe kigwara, ibindi vyose bigwarana na co. Kandi iyo igihimba kimwe cubashwe, ibindi vyose binezeranwa na co.
Namwe muri umubiri wa Kristo, kandi umwe wese muri mwebwe ni igihimba c’uwo mubiri.

Ibi ni vyo bihimba vy’umubiri Imana yashize mw’ishengero: hari intumwa, abavugishwa n’Imana, abigisha, abakora ibitangaza, abafise ingabire zo gukiza ingwara, abafise ingabire zo gufasha abandi, abafise ingabire z’uburongozi, n’abavuga indimi zitandukanye.
Mbega bose ni intumwa? Mbega bose ni abavugishwa n’Imana? Mbega bose ni abigisha? Bose bakora ibitangaza?
Bose bafise ingabire zo gukiza ingwara? Bose bavuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana? Bose basobanura indimi?
Ariko mwipfuze ingabire zisumba izindi zose.

headings.text: Turi ingingo nyinshi zigize umubiri umwe

verses.text: Naho novuga indimi z’abantu n’iz’abamarayika ntagira urukundo, noba meze nk’inkengeri canke icuma gisamirana.
Naho nogira ingabire yo kuvugishwa n’Imana, nkagira ukwizera kwokwimura imisozi ariko ntagira urukundo, vyoba ari ubusa.
Naho nofata ivyanje vyose nkabiha abakene, ndetse naho notanga umubiri wanje kugira ngo ngire ico nirata ariko ntagira urukundo, vyoba ari ubusa.
Urukundo rurihangana, rugira neza, ntirugira ishari, ntirwihayagiza, kandi ntirwishira hejuru.
Ntiruteza isoni abandi, ntirurondera inyungu zarwo, ntirutwarwa n’ishavu, kandi ntirubika ikibi.
Urukundo ntirunezerererwa ikibi, ariko runezererwa ukuri.
Urukundo ntirucika intege, ntirutakaza ukwizera, ntirutakaza ivyizigiro, rukomeza kwihanganira ibihe uko bije kwose.
Urukundo ntiruzigera rurangira. Kuvugishwa n’Imana, kuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana, n’ubwenge budasanzwe bizohera.
Ubwenge dufise ubu ni agace gatoya, kandi n’ukuvugishwa n’Imana kwacu ni agace gatoya.
Ariko igihe kizogera aho vyose bizokwuzuzwa, maze ivy’ibice bikurweho.
Nkiri umwana navuga nk’umwana nkiyumvira nk’umwana. Ariko maze gukura niyambuye ivy’ubwana vyose.
Ivyo tubona ubu ni nk’ishusho yo mu cirore, ariko hazogera igihe tuzobona vyose neza amaso mu yandi. Ubu tuzi agace, ariko hari igihe tuzomenya vyose, nk’uko Imana ituzi neza.
None rero hari ibintu bitatu bizokwamaho: ukwizera, ivyizigiro n’urukundo. Ariko igikuru muri vyose ni urukundo.

headings.text: Urukundo ruruta vyose Reka ndabereke inzira irashe gusumba izindi zose.

verses.text: Murondere kugira urukundo kandi mwipfuze cane kuronka ingabire za Mpwemu, na canecane ingabire y’ukuvugishwa n’Imana.
Uwuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana ntaba ariko arabwira abantu, ahubwo aba ariko arabwira Imana, kandi nta n’uwushobora kumutahura. Impwemu yiwe iba iriko iravuga amabanga.
Ariko uwuvugishwa n’Imana aba ariko arabwira abantu kugira ngo bakomezwe, baterwe intege bongere birurwe.
Uwuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana aba ariko ariyubaka we nyene, ariko uwuvugishwa n’Imana aba ariko arubaka ishengero.

Nipfuza ko mwese muvuga mu ndimi, ariko ikirengeye ni uko mwovugishwa n’Imana. Uwuvugishwa n’Imana arahambaye gusumba uwuvuga mu ndimi, kiretse mu gihe yoba ashobora kuzisobanura kugira ishengero ryose rikomezwe.
Bene Data, mbega iyo nza iwanyu mvuga mu ndimi, nari kubamarira iki ntabazaniye ivyo nahishuriwe, amajambo y’ubwenge, ubuvugishwa canke inyigisho?
Ni ko bimeze no ku bicurarangisho bisanzwe bitagira ubuzima, nk’umwironge canke inanga. Mbega bivuze co kimwe, hari uwoshobora kumenya ikivugijwe?
Kandi n’inzamba itavugijwe mw’ijwi ribereye, abasoda bomenya ko bahamagawe ngo baje ku rugamba?
No kuri mwebwe ni uko. Mutavuze amajambo atahurika mu rurimi rwanyu, nta womenya ico muriko muravuga. Mwoba muriko mubwira ikirere gusa.
Kw’isi hari indimi nyinshi, kandi nta na rumwe rutagira ico rusigura.
None rero, ntaronse insiguro y’ivyo mbariwe noba ndi umunyamahanga kuri uwo ambarira, kandi na we nyene yoba ari umunyamahanga kuri jewe.
Na mwebwe ni uko. Ko mufise umwete wo kurondera ingabire za Mpwemu, mukore ibishoboka kugira muronke ingabire zubaka ishengero.
Ni co gituma nimba hari uwuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana yari akwiye gusenga Imana ngo imushoboze gusobanura ivyo avuga.
Kuko iyo nsenga mu ndimi zitamenyekana, impwemu yanje ni yo iba iriko irasenga, ariko simba ndiko nkoresha ubwenge bwanje.
None ndabigenze gute? Nzosengesha impwemu yanje, ariko nzosengesha n’ubwenge. Nzoririmbisha impwemu yanje, ariko kandi nzoririmbisha n’ubwenge bwanje.
Nimwaba muriko muratazira Imana n’impwemu zanyu zonyene, abatabitahura bokwifatanya namwe gute, bakavuga “Amen” ku bw’amashimwe yanyu, kandi batumva ivyo muvuga?
Mushobora kuba muriko murashima Imana cane, ariko ntibizofasha abariko barabumva.
Ndashima Imana ko mvuga mu ndimi kubasumvya.
Ariko mu rusengero, mpitamwo kuvuga amajambo yumvikana atanu arimwo inyigisho aho kuvuga amajambo ibihumbi cumi mu ndimi zitamenyekana.
Bene Data, ntimube nk’abana bato mu gutahura ibi. Mube abana bato ku bijanye n’icaha, ariko mube nk’abakuze mu gutahura ibintu nk’ibi.
Mu vyagezwe haranditswe ngo: “Nzobwira abantu banje mu ndimi zitazwi, nkoresheje akanwa ka ba kavantara. Ariko na ho nyene, ntibazonyumvira.” Ni ko Umwami Imana avuze.
Indimi zitamenyekana rero ni ikimenyetso ku batizera, si ku bizera. Ariko ubuvugishwa ntibuhari ku neza y’abizera, ni ku y’abatizera.
None rero, abatizera canke abantu badatahura ivyo kuvuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana baje mu makoraniro y’ishengero yanyu, bakumva muvuga mu ndimi zitamenekana, bazokwibaza ko mwasaze.

Ariko abatizera canke abadatahura ivyo kuvuga indimi zitamenyekana nibaza bagasanga mwese muriko muravugishwa, bazokwemezwa mu mitima yabo ko ari abanyavyaha, kandi ko bazocirwa urubanza n’ivyo muvuga,
maze ivyinyegeje mu mitima yabo bizobe bigiye ahabona. Bazoheza bakubite ibipfukamiro hasi bahimbaze Imana, bavuge bati: “Vy’ukuri Imana iri kumwe namwe!”

Muri make rero bene Data, iyo mukoraniye hamwe, hazobe uwuririmba, uwundi yigishe, uwundi avuge ico Imana yamuhishuriye, uwundi avuge mu ndimi zitamenyekana, uwundi na we azisobanure. Ariko vyose bikorwe ku buryo bibubaka mwese.
Abantu nka babiri canke batatu gusa azobe ari bo bavuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana kandi havuge umwumwe, hongere habeho uwuzisobanura.
Ata musobanuzi ahari, uwo muntu ntazovuge mu rusengero, azokwiganirire n’Imana wenyene.
Abantu nka babiri canke batatu bazotange ubuvugishwa, abandi na bo basese, bihweze ivyavuzwe.
Nimba hari uwicaye mu rusengero hanyuma akagira ico abwiwe n’Umwami Imana, uwari asanzwe ariko aravuga azoce abanza ahagarike.
Abavugishwa n’Imana bose bazokuranwa kuvuga, umwe avuge uwundi ahejeje, kugira mugire ico mutahuye hanyuma muterwe intege.
Abavugishwa n’Imana bategerezwa kuganza impwemu zabo, bagakuranwa kuvuga,
kuko Imana yacu atari Imana y’akajagari, ariko ari Imana y’amahoro, nk’uko bigenda mu mashengero yose y’abera.
Abagore bazogume banumye mu makoraniro y’ishengero. Si vyiza ko bavuga, ahubwo bicishe bugufi nk’uko ivyagezwe bivuga.
Bafise ico bagomba kubaza, bazokibarize abagabo babo i muhira. Kuko bitabereye ko umugore avuga mu makoraniro y’ishengero.
Mbega ijambo ry’Imana ryamutse muri mwebwe Abakorinto? Canke mwibaza ko ari mwebwe mwenyene ryahawe?
Nimba muri mwebwe hari uwibwira ko ari umuvugishwa n’Imana canke afise ingabire za Mpwemu Yera, akwiye kwemera ko ivyo ndabandikiye ari ibwirizwa rivuye ku Mwami Imana.
Uwutavyemera, na we ntazokwemerwa.
None rero bene Data, mwipfuze kuvugishwa n’Imana, kandi ntimubuze abavugishwa n’Imana mu ndimi zitamenyekana.
Ariko vyose bikorwe mu buryo bubereye, kandi mu rutonde.

headings.text: Ibintu vyose bikwiye gukorwa mu rutonde

verses.text: Ubu na ho bene Data, nagomba kubibutsa Ubutumwa Bwiza nababwiye, ubwo mwakiriye mukabugumamwo.
Ubwo Butumwa ni bwo bubakiza hamwe mugumije amajambo nababwiye. Ahandi ho ukwizera kwanyu kwoba ari ukw’ubusa.
Kuko ivyo nahawe ari vyo nabashikirije nk’ivy’igiciro vya mbere: ko Kristo yapfiriye ivyaha vyacu, nk’uko Ivyanditswe Vyera bibivuga,
ko yahambwe hanyuma akazuka ku musi ugira gatatu nk’uko Ivyanditswe Vyera bibivuga,
kandi ko yiyeretse Kefa, hanyuma yiyereka bamwe cumi na babiri.
Inyuma yaho yiyerekera rimwe bene Data barenga amajana atanu, kandi n’aho benshi muri bo bamaze gupfa, bamwe muri bo baracariho.
Maze yiyereka Yakobo, yongera yiyereka n’izindi ntumwa zose,
Ubwa nyuma aranyiyereka nanje, nk’uwavutse igihe kitari co.
Koko ndi uwa nyuma mu ntumwa kandi simbereye kwitwa intumwa, kuko nahamye ishengero ry’Imana.
Ariko ndi uwo ndi kubera ubuntu bw’Imana, kandi ubwo buntu ntibwapfuye ubusa. Nakoze cane gusumba izindi ntumwa, ariko ntiyari jewe, bwari ubuntu bw’Imana bukorera muri jewe.
Ariko yaba jewe, yaba bo, ivyo ni vyo twigisha, kandi ni vyo mwizeye.
None rero nimba twigisha ko Kristo yazutse mu bapfuye, ni kubera iki bamwe muri mwebwe bavuga ko ukuzuka kw’abapfuye kutabaho?
Nimba ata kuzuka kw’abapfuye kubaho, na Kristo rero ntiyazutse.
Kandi nimba Kristo atazutse, inyigisho zacu ni iz’ubusa, kandi n’ukwizera kwanyu ni ukw’ubusa.
Kandi ikirengeye ivyo, twebwe intumwa twoba tubeshera Imana, kuko twama dushinga intahe ko Imana yazuye Kristo mu bapfuye. Ariko nimba Imana itamuzuye mu bapfuye, koko nta kuzuka kw’abapfuye kubaho.
Kandi nimba abapfuye batazozurwa, na Kristo ntiyazuwe mu bapfuye.
Nimba na ho Kristo atazutse, ukwizera kwanyu ni ukw’ubusa, muracagendera mu vyaha vyanyu.
Mbere n’abapfiriye muri Kristo ntibazosubira kubaho.
Nimba ivyizigiro vyacu muri Kristo ari ivy’ubu buzima gusa, turi abahombe gusumba abandi bantu bose.
Ariko koko Kristo yarazutse mu bapfuye, amera kurya kw’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi, aba icemeza ko abapfuye bazozuka.
Nk’uko urupfu rwazanywe n’umuntu, n’ukuzuka kw’abapfuye na kwo kwazanywe n’umuntu.
Nk’uko muri Adamu bose bapfuye, muri Kristo bose bazogirwa bazima.
Ariko hazoba urukurikirane mu kuzuka: Kristo yarazutse nk’ivyeze imbere y’ibindi; hanyuma abamukurikiye bose bazozuka niyagaruka.
Inyuma y’aho hazoca haza umuhero wa vyose, aho azotanga Ubwami akabushikiriza Imana Data, amaze gusangangura ububasha bwose, ubutware bwose n’ubushobozi bwose.
Kuko ategerezwa kuganza gushitsa ashize abansi biwe musi y’ibirenge vyiwe.
Umwansi azosangangurwa ubwa nyuma ni rupfu.

Kuko Ivyanditswe Vyera bivuga biti: “Imana yashize vyose musi y’ububasha bwiwe.” Ariko rero iyo bivuze ko “vyose” biri musi y’ububasha bwiwe, biragaragara ko bitaba bishizemwo n’Imana kuko ni yo ishira vyose musi y’ububasha bwa Kristo.
Maze vyose nivyamara gushirwa musi y’ububasha bwa Kristo, na we azoja musi y’ububasha bw’Imana yashize vyose musi y’ububasha bw’Umwana wayo, Imana na yo hejuru ya vyose muri vyose.
Nimba ata zuka ririho, none abo babatizwa mu kibanza c’abapfuye babigira biteze iki? Nimba abapfuye batazozuka, ni kubera iki hari ababatizwa mu kibanza cabo?
Kandi ni kubera iki natwe twishira mu ntambara umwanya wose?
Bene Data, ndababwije ukuri ko mpakwa kwicwa ku musi ku musi. Ibi ni ukuri bimeze nk’umunezero mfise kubera ivyo Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo yakoze muri mwebwe.

Nimba naragwanye n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba muri Efeso, ata yindi nyungu niteze atari ivyizigiro vyo mu mubiri gusa, nzoba nungutse iki? Kandi nimba ata kuzuka kuriho, nk’uko wa mugani uvuga: “Reka twirire twongere twinywere, kuko ejo tuzopfa.”
Ntihagire uwubazimiza: “Abagenzi babi bonona ingeso nziza z’umuntu.”
Garura ubwenge nk’uko bibereye, mureke kwama mukora ivyaha. Ibi ndabivuze kugira ngo ndabatere kugira isoni, kuko bamwe muri mwebwe bataramenya Imana na gato.
Ariko bamwe muri mwebwe barabaza bati: “Mbega abapfuye bozozuka gute? Bazoba bafise umubiri umeze gute?”
Mwa mburabwenge mwe! Imbuto ntishobora kumera itabanje gupfa.
Ico mubiba si urya mutumba w’igiterwa ukura, ahubwo ni imbuto zisanzwe, zaba ingano canke izindi mbuto.
Hanyuma Imana ikayiha umutumba nk’uko yabiteguye, kandi igatanga imitumba itandukanye bivanye n’imbuto.
Imibiri yose ntimeze co kimwe: abantu bafise imibiri yabo, ibikoko bikagira iyavyo, inyoni zikagira iyazo, n’amafi akagira iyayo.
Hari ibiba mu kirere, hakaba n’ibiba kw’isi, ariko ibiba mu kirere bifise ugukayangana kwavyo, ivyo kw’isi bikagira ugukayangana kwavyo.
Izuba rigira ugukayangana kwaryo, ukwezi kukagira ugukayangana kwakwo, inyenyeri na zo zikagira ugukayangana kwazo, kandi n’inyenyeri ubwazo zigira ugukayangana gutandukanye.
Ni ko bizoba bimeze ku musi w’izuka ry’abapfuye. Uwu mubiri uhambwa ni uwubora, ariko uzozurirwa kubaho ibihe vyose.
Imibiri yacu ihambwa ata co imaze, ariko izozurirwa ubwiza butangaje. Ihambwa ari iminyantegenke ariko izozurirwa kuba inyenkomezi.
Ihambwa ari imibiri y’abantu nk’uko tuyibona, ariko izozurwa ari imibiri yo mu buryo bw’impwemu. Kuko nk’uko hari imibiri isanzwe, hariho n’imibiri yo mu buryo bw’impwemu.
Ivyanditswe bivuga ngo: “Umuntu wa mbere, ari we Adamu, yabaye uwufise ubuzima,” Adamu wa nyuma, ari we Kristo yaje ari Impwemu itanga ubugingo.
Uw’impwemu si we yaje ubwa mbere, habanje kuza uw’umubiri, hanyuma haza uw’impwemu.
Umuntu wa mbere, ari we Adamu, yavuye mw’ivu, uwo hanyuma, ni we Kristo, yavuye mw’ijuru.
Ab’isi bameze nk’uwo mu muntu w’isi, ariko abo mw’ijuru bameze nk’uwo muntu wo mw’ijuru.
Kandi nk’uko twavutse dufise kamere muntu k’abo kw’isi, ni ko tuzoba dufise kamere k’abo mw’ijuru.
Ico ngomba kubabwira bene Data, ni uko uwu mubiri twambaye utazoragwa Ubwami bw’Imana, kandi ibibora vyose ntibizoragwa ibihoraho.
Ariko reka ndababwire ibanga rihambaye: ntituzopfa, ahubwo tuzohindurwa ukundi.
Bizoba mu kanya isase, nk’uwukubise urugohe, igihe inzamba izovuga. Niyavuga abazoba barapfuye bazoca bazukira kubaho ibihe vyose. Natwe tuzoba tukiri bazima, tuzoca duhindurwa ukundi.
Uyu mubiri wacu ubora uzoca wambara ukutabora, kandi uwu mubiri wacu upfa uzoca wambara ukudapfa.
Maze uwu mubiri ubora umaze kwambara ukutabora, n’ugupfa kwawo kukambara ukudapfa, ni ho ibi vyanditswe bizoba bishitse, ngo: “Urupfu rwamizwe n’intsinzi.”
“Wa rupfu we, intsinzi yawe iri hehe? Wa rupfu we, uruboyi rwawe ruri he?”
Kuko icaha ni uruboyi ruzana urupfu, kandi ubushobozi bw’icaha buri mu vyagezwe.
Ariko Imana ishimwe, kuko iduha intsinzi muri Yesu Kristo.
None bene Data nkunda, mushikame ntihagire ikibanyiganyiza. Mwiyegurire imisi yose gukorera Umwami wacu kuko muzi neza ko ibikorwa vyanyu atari impfagusa mu Mwami.
Ku bijanye no kwegeranya uburyo bwo gufasha abizera b’i Yerusalemu, mubikore nk’uko nabihanuye amashengero y’i Galatiya.
Ku musi wa mbere w’indwi, umwe wese muri mwebwe arabika amahera ku yo yungutse. Ntimuzorindire ko nshika hiyo hanyuma ngo muce muyatoreza rimwe.
Ninashika hiyo, nzokwandika amakete nzorungikana abo muzoba mwatoranije kugira batware imfashanyo zanyu i Yerusalemu.
Kandi nivyaba nkenerwa ko njana na bo, bazomperekeza.
Nzobagendera mvuye i Makedoniya kuko nipfuza gucayo.
Ndashobora kuzomarana namwe igihe, mbere nshobora kuhamara igihe c’imbeho nyinshi cane, kugira ngo muzomfashe ku bijanye no kubandanya urugendo, iyo nzoba ngiye hose.
Sinshaka kuhaca ndengana, nipfuza kumarana namwe umwanya ukwiye Umwami Imana abikunze.
Ariko mu kurindira nzoba ndagumye aha muri Efeso gushitsa ku musi wa Pentekote,
kuko hariho akaryo keza ko gukorera Imana naho hari abangwanya benshi.
Timoteyo niyashika hiyo, muzomwakire neza kugira agubwe neza muri mwebwe, kuko ariko akora igikorwa c’Umwami co kimwe nanje.
Ntihazogire uwumugaya, ahubwo mumuhezagize ibikenewe mu rugendo rwiwe agarutse. Twe na bene Data tumurindiranye igishika.
Ku vyerekeye mwene Data Apolo na we, naramwinginze ngo azanane n’abandi bene Data iwanyu, ariko ntiyipfuje kuza ubwo nyene, azoza niyaronka akaryo keza.
Mube maso, mushikame mu kwizera, mube abagabo, mugire umwete, mugire umutima rugabo.
Ivyo mukora vyose mubikore mu rukundo.
Murazi ko abo mu muryango wa Setefana ari bo bizeye ubwa mbere muri Akaya, baca bihebera gukorera abizera: ndabinginze rero bene Data,
ngo murongorwe n’abantu nka bo, canke n’abifatanije na bo muri ico gikorwa.
Naranezerewe cane numvise ko Setefana, Forotunate na Akayiko bashitse ngaha. Bamfashishije ivyo nari nkeneye vyose mu kibanza canyu.
Baranteye intege nk’uko babateye intege. Abantu nk’abo ni abo gushimira ku bw’ibikorwa vyiza bakora.
Amashengero yo muri Aziya arabatasha. Akwilasi na Pirisila na bo barabatasha cane mu Mwami, co kimwe n’ishengero rikoranira mu nzu yabo.
Bene Data bose turi kumwe hano barabatasha. Muramukanye mu kugumbirana kwera.
Jewe Pawulo, ndabandikiye ndabatasha n’ukuboko kwanje.
Nimba hariho uwudakunda Umwami, uwo aravumwe. Kaze Mwami!
Ubuntu bw’Umwami wacu Yesu bubane namwe.
Ndabakunda mwese muri Kristo Yesu. Amen.
